description: This Java class encapsulates a content item for sharing purposes, supporting content referencing via resource ID or asset file path, and provides methods to generate content URIs and share intents.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: A class representing a shareable content item, supporting image and text types, with methods to generate URIs and share intents.

methods.name: ContentItem(int, int)
methods.description: Constructor for creating a ContentItem referencing a resource ID.

methods.name: ContentItem(int, String)
methods.description: Constructor for creating a ContentItem referencing an asset file path.

methods.name: getContentUri
methods.description: Returns a Uri to the content if an asset file path is set.

methods.name: getShareIntent
methods.description: Creates an Intent to share the content, setting type and extras based on content type.
